primitives.name: Second-Source Evidence Accumulator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Rule: every major claim confirmed by a second source or explicitly flagged.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P(H|E)': 'Posterior probability of hypothesis given evidence', 'P(E|H)': 'Likelihood of evidence given hypothesis', 'P(H)': 'Prior probability of hypothesis'}
primitives.assumptions: Claims must be independently verifiable by at least two distinct sources; evidence is conditionally independent.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P(H|E) < threshold, claim is flagged as unverified.

layer2.mapping: Bayesian update rule P(H|E) ∝ P(E|H)P(H) applied to claim validation across multiple data streams.
layer2.telemetry: Number of corroborating sources per claim

primitives.name: Player Status Transition Graph
primitives.verbatim_quote: - DK Network table tags: Darnold $5,400 (D), Murray $5,100 (Q) → both OUT.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S(t)': 'Player status at time t ∈ {IN, OUT, DOUBTFUL}', 'T': 'Transition time interval'}
primitives.assumptions: Status changes are discrete events with deterministic or probabilistic transitions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S(t) ≠ S(t−1), transition is logged and validated.

layer2.mapping: Temporal graph traversal of player injury/status updates using GSE state machine logic.
layer2.telemetry: Change in player status flags over time

primitives.name: Conflicting Source Signal Detector
primitives.verbatim_quote: - hellorookie "Mahomes first game since ACL/LCL tear" → conflicts with W1 game + DKN projection.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_i': 'Claim i from source i', 'S_i': 'Source i reliability score', 'Conflict(C_i, C_j)': 'Boolean indicating contradiction between claims'}
primitives.assumptions: Sources may have conflicting information; conflict resolution requires cross-referencing.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If Conflict(C_i, C_j) = true and S_i < threshold, flag for review.

layer2.mapping: Binary conflict detection function modeled as logical conjunction of claim discrepancy and source credibility.
layer2.telemetry: Boolean conflict flag per claim pair
